ideas.pitch: A personal AI agent that analyzes the user's progress through HackoSquad 2026 missions and auto-generates customized practice web vulnerabilities and defense-in-depth hints using Claude.
ideas.title: AgentShield CTF Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the beginner-friendly cybersecurity education mission of the hackathon while utilizing advanced defense-in-depth prompting techniques proven in previous security challenges.

ideas.pitch: A Python security insights tool that scans student repositories during the 7-day missions to automatically highlight insecure coding patterns, missing validation, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
ideas.title: VulnQuery Repo Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the learning objective of identifying and investigating attacks, mirroring tools that automate repository analysis and security reports.

ideas.pitch: A BERT-powered spam and phishing detection system tailored to catch social engineering tactics, malicious emails, and SMS lures typical in early CTF phishing challenges.
ideas.title: PhishGuard AI Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven NLP spam detection mechanics specifically for the offensive and defensive security scenarios taught during Cyber Week.

ideas.pitch: A ZK-gated community and credential verification platform for CTF participants that proves challenge completion without leaking underlying flag secrets or solution write-ups.
ideas.title: ZeroTrust Agent Gate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous cryptographic access control principles to the competition environment, showcasing hard engineering in zero-knowledge proofs.

ideas.pitch: A deterministic engagement gate and edge telemetry log visualizer designed to detect anomalous traffic patterns and brute-force attempts during the final live CTF challenge.
ideas.title: SecOps Edge Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides tangible utility during the final live CTF competition by monitoring defensive posture and logging suspicious connection requests in real-time.
